caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright pottery vessel positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The vessel has a cylindrical upper portion that transitions into a wider, rounded midsection, before narrowing again slightly at the base. The color of the vessel is a warm, earthy brown with subtle gradients, giving it a slightly textured, clay-like appearance. There is shading along the edges and bottom, suggesting a light source from the left, which adds depth to the shape. Near the bottom right of the image, there is a handwritten signature in brownish ink that reads "Ed Bashaw." The composition is simple, featuring only the vessel as the focal object with no additional elements or decorations, and the background remains unembellished except for a few small, faint marks or spots.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
